about: Each skill's wick for the one build (docs/design/ONE_BUILD.md 4): twelve lamps in three strands of four, the fourth a Turn, and Unions shared by two skills. The warden's seven skills are written in full. The game does not read this file yet: the build lead wires it (ONE_BUILD 5) and it replaces wicks.json, the evolutions and catalysts in skills.json and the unions' merge. effects: {do: turn} is a built Turn (its wicks.json keys, Sim/Turns.cs); {do: evolve} a built evolution's behavior (tags, art, set, triggers) with skipMods the multipliers the one build retires, because rank carries a skill's power and the card shows it; {do: rule} a named rule (the v1 lamps.json rule ids where they exist, new ids prefixed with the skill); {do: set} built Turn keys (school, status) applied alone. engine: built (the sim does it today), rule (a named rule exists), new (to build). supersedes: lead-ins whose effect the Turn takes over (they keep their rank). draft: the name waits for the story writer. Numbers are first numbers, not tuned: the harness (ONE_BUILD 6) measures them. keywords: the card's one-line explanations, read when a card is held. Checked by tools/classes/skill_lamps_check.py.

rules.run: The ember burns only in a run (table nights, maps, story nights, the prologue's Ford); her build is whole everywhere and every lamp works in full.
rules.opens: Each skill opens at a level per type (skills[].opens): Oathblade and Judgment Disc at 1, her type's signatures at 1-3, the other type's at 4-6; she carries any open skill her calling may carry, swapped at a lamp-post in town.

points.lit: a point burns once it is lit: Light my way lights the points she leaves to it each time she comes into a town, and a lamp-post is where she lights or changes them herself; a new character's first run (the Ford) has none lit

costs.unionFrom: 1 from each of its two skills

rank.is: the points burning on the skill's wick, oil and ember together (a Union's point counts on each of its skills)
rank.eachRank: the skill's growth: that share of its base damage
rank.growthSource: skills.json growth; absent (oathblade) it is Weapons.DamageStep, 0.2
rank.zero: with no point burning a skill is rank 0, its first hit (the build lead maps it onto today's weapon rank 1)
rank.card: the skill's hit before and after, the lamp's own change counted: 'hit 41 -> 45 (rank 4 -> 5)', a Turn '41 -> 49'; a cost lamp's can fall (Hot Iron '41 -> 38'), and a hit that splits shows its parts (Threefold '41 -> 3 x 14')
rank.outOfRunMostSource: Weapons.MaxRank (today it also caps SkillBook.Rank and the 'at rank 8 it evolves' hint)
rank.runMostIs: 13 from its lamps (nine lead-ins and two Turns), 1 more for each Union it shares, and Hotter adds up to 10 a night across all her skills

turnRule.secondNeeds: a Turn on the same skill lit with oil

respec.lightMyWay: lights unplanned points each time she comes into a town: the dawn card's lamp first, then the suggested strand, then the header's next strand once it is full

candidates: for every carried skill, the first dark lamp of each strand whose parent burns
a Turn only if the Turn rule allows it
every Union whose two skills each burn a Turn

alwaysDealt.which: the ready Turn or Union on the skill that has dealt the most damage tonight (ties: the one ready longest, then the skill carried first)
ready: a Turn whose three lead-ins burn, if the Turn rule allows it
a Union whose two skills each burn a Turn
alwaysDealt.others: the other ready Turns and Unions are drawn at the readyNotDealt weight
alwaysDealt.today: LevelUp.Draft deals one weapon's evolutions at a time, and a Union only when no evolution is ready

weights.multiply: weights multiply: the next lamp on the suggested strand, already burning, is 3 x 1.5 = 4.5

offer.continuesStrand: a lamp that continues a strand already burning (oil or ember)
offer.justShown: a card in the offer just before (a reroll looks again)

spread.while: two or more skills have candidates

never: a lamp whose parent is dark
a Turn the Turn rule forbids
a lamp banished tonight (a banish closes its strand for the night, and the card says so)

card.shows: the lamp's name, the skill's glyph, its strand's pips (which lamp of four), the one line, and the skill's hit rising with its rank
card.turn: drawn larger; one that takes over a lead-in's effect says so: 'takes Third Blow's place' (the lead-in keeps its rank)
card.secondTurn: says why it may burn: 'beside Splitting Stroke, lit for good'
card.keywords: marked on the line, case-sensitive ('Stone' marks, 'standing stones' doesn't); held, each reads its one line (keywords)
card.setsAside: on one skill a Turn's rule wins over a lead-in's on the same thing (a wait, a timer, its targets), and slows and speeds multiply; the card names what it sets aside, and a lead-in offered while that Turn burns says so; two Turns on one skill both hold, and counts multiply (Aegis Wheel beside Threefold throws six small discs)

offer.fewer: fewer candidates than cards: the surplus fills the rest

wickPanel.darkTurn: one Turn on this skill; a second only in a run, beside one lit for good

cards.name: Hotter
cards.rule: The skill that has dealt the most tonight burns 1 rank hotter until first light, its hit shown rising; 10 a night in all.

cards.name: Banked
cards.rule: A third of a Flare, banked at once.

rules.firstLight: puts out every lamp the ember lit and the ranks they brought, and the ember sinks back to nothing; oil lamps and the levels the night taught stay (ONE_BUILD 3)
rules.rise: a rise is not a level: the ember rises about 23 times in a tier-1 night (10 minutes, teeth.json), each rise deals an offer, and the ember sinks back to nothing at first light; her level comes from what the night teaches, and it stays

keywords.rank: Each rank adds the skill's growth to its hit (16% of its first hit for most skills). Each lamp lit adds a rank, a Turn two.
keywords.Turn: A Turn ends a strand and changes what the skill is.
keywords.oil: Lit with oil: a point spent at a lamp-post. It burns for good, in every fight.
keywords.ember: Lit by the ember: free in a run, and out at first light.
keywords.rise: Each time the ember rises it deals three cards, four with luck. A rise is not a level.
keywords.Union: A lamp two skills share once each burns a Turn. Both keep firing, and it adds a rank to each.
keywords.heavy: A heavy blow staggers what it strikes; enough of them break a champion.
keywords.sear: Seared things take 30% more from holy light, and the dead burn while seared.
keywords.bleed: A bleed deals its damage over its seconds.
keywords.burning: Burning deals its damage over its seconds.
keywords.barrier: A barrier takes blows before your health does, and fades in time. 'Held at most' counts all your barrier: past it, that lamp gives none.
keywords.Stone: Every blow that reaches you lays a Stone; a dodged one lays none. At six, the wall answers.
keywords.the wall answers: At six Stones the wall answers: a Rebuke 8 m all round you, and the Stones are spent.
keywords.block: Your shield turns some blows on its own. Each turned blow is a block.
keywords.perfect dash: A dash made just before a blow lands.
keywords.champion: A pack's leader, or a boss.
keywords.lesser things: The horde: anything that isn't a champion.
keywords.daylight: Daylight lies on the ground where Dawnpulse leaves it, and burns what stands in it.
keywords.stunned: A stunned thing can't move or strike.
keywords.slowed: A slowed thing moves and strikes slower.

skills.name: Shield Charge
skills.why: the Ram first: its barrier is the charge's safety, so a player who never plans goes in protected

skills.name: Heroic Leap
skills.why: opens mirror Shield Charge (each type's movement skill at 1, the other's at 4); the Quake first because the landing is the leap's hit

skills.name: Butcher's Cleaver
skills.why: sunderer at 2 so Bladestorm (Cleaver + Sunder) is in reach by the first Union; the Wound first because bleed serves both callings (the reaver's opens are her wave's)

skills.name: Iron Vow
skills.why: the bulwark's brace opens beside the bell at 3; the Hoard first because the burst is the vow's payoff

lamps.name: Crescent
lamps.rule: Every third swing throws a crescent of light 6 m ahead.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.oathblade.morning_edge (a crescent every swing; now every third, and the Turn gives every swing)

lamps.name: Blessed Steel
lamps.rule: Oathblade turns holy: its cuts and crescents sear what they strike for 1 s.
lamps.from: the built Holy Turn's school swap (wicks.json turns.holy), without its 10%

lamps.name: Onward
lamps.rule: A crescent that kills throws another on from where it fell, at 50%, once a swing.

lamps.name: Oathkeeper
lamps.rule: Every swing throws a 2 m crescent of holy light that runs on through the whole crowd.
lamps.from: evolution oathkeeper (catalyst ironhide goes; its mods damage 1.12, cooldown 0.85, area 1.2 retire: rank carries the power)

lamps.name: Notched
lamps.rule: Oathblade's cuts bleed for 35% of the blow over 3 s.
lamps.from: Grave-Edge's bleed, lit first (the evolution's set.status)

lamps.name: Open Wound
lamps.rule: A cut on a bleeding thing starts its bleed over, 50% deeper.

lamps.name: Let Blood
lamps.rule: Oathblade strikes 25% softer, but each cut bleeds for 80% of the blow.

lamps.name: Grave-Edge
lamps.rule: The edge drinks: anything bleeding below a sixth (17%) of its life dies at the next cut.
lamps.from: evolution graveedge (catalyst serration goes; its mods damage 1.91, cooldown 0.9 retire)

lamps.name: On Guard
lamps.rule: A block or a perfect dash swings Oathblade at once, at most every 0.5 s.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.oathblade.shield_and_edge (blocks only; the perfect dash lets every calling answer)

lamps.name: Blow for Blow
lamps.rule: A blow that reaches you swings Oathblade at once too, at most every 1 s.

lamps.name: Slow to Draw
lamps.rule: Oathblade's own swings come 25% slower, but each answer strikes 50% harder.

lamps.name: The Answer
lamps.rule: Oathblade answers every block, perfect dash and blow on you, as often as every 0.3 s; its own swings come half as often.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: a trigger Turn)

lamps.name: Found Wanting
lamps.rule: Each thing the disc kills gives it one more ricochet, 5 more at most a throw.

lamps.name: Kept Aloft
lamps.rule: A ricochet off a champion keeps the disc flying 0.5 s longer.

lamps.name: Weighed
lamps.rule: Each ricochet seeks the strongest thing within 6 m, not the nearest.

lamps.name: Reckoning
lamps.rule: The disc ricochets for as long as it flies, each strike 8% heavier than the last.
lamps.from: evolution reckoning (catalysts fortune, precision go; its bounces +6 and damage 1.28 become what its words promised: endless ricochets that grow heavier)

lamps.name: First Ward
lamps.rule: The disc's first strike each throw gives you a barrier of 2% of health.

lamps.name: Arrowbreaker
lamps.rule: The disc flies 25% slower, but it breaks every missile it passes through.

lamps.name: Turned Aside
lamps.rule: Each missile the disc breaks flies back at whoever loosed it, at 100% of the disc's strike.
lamps.from: new (C2 lead 2: Close Behind, a conditional Aegis Wheel, retires)

lamps.name: Aegis Wheel
lamps.rule: Two discs fly each throw, and every ricochet gives you a barrier of 1% of health, 20% held at most.
lamps.from: evolution aegis_wheel (catalysts ironhide, vitality go; damage 1.72 retires; the second disc and the barrier stay)

lamps.name: Last Word
lamps.rule: The disc's last ricochet bursts into 3 shards that fly on 5 m, each at 40%.

lamps.name: Cloven
lamps.rule: A heavy throw splits in two, each at 75% (a stalker: a throw within 1 s of a dash).

lamps.name: Splinters
lamps.rule: The disc flies 25% slower, but its shards ricochet twice each.

lamps.name: Threefold
lamps.rule: Three smaller discs fly each throw, each at 28% damage and 75% size.

lamps.name: Kind Light
lamps.rule: A pulse that strikes 5 or more mends you 3% of health.

lamps.name: Sun in Their Eyes
lamps.rule: Dawnpulse strikes 20% softer, but what it sears strikes you 15% weaker.

lamps.name: Mantle
lamps.rule: For 2 s after each pulse, whatever strikes you is seared.

lamps.name: Circle of Dawn
lamps.rule: Dawnpulse answers blows, not its timer: it fires each time a blow reaches you, at most every 1 s, and mends you 1% of health for each thing it strikes, 8% at most.
lamps.from: evolution circle_of_dawn (catalysts vitality, recovery go; damage 2.05, area 1.2 retire; its heal for each thing struck stays, as a share of health); off its timer onto blows on her is new

lamps.name: Sunstruck
lamps.rule: A pulse that strikes a champion leaves daylight 2 m round under it, burning 3 s at 30% a second.

lamps.name: Morning Road
lamps.rule: Where you dash, daylight lies behind you for 2 s, burning at 30% of the pulse a second.
lamps.from: new (C2 lead 2: Standing Ring, a smaller Sunbreak, retires; Sunstruck moves first)

lamps.name: Burnt Offering
lamps.rule: Dawnpulse comes 25% slower, but what dies in its daylight bursts 2 m round at 50% of the pulse.

lamps.name: Sunbreak
lamps.rule: Each pulse leaves a ring of daylight 3.5 m round that burns 2.5 s, at 30% of the pulse a second.
lamps.from: evolution sunbreak (catalyst might goes; damage 2.26 retires; set.groundOnHit stays)

lamps.name: Dawn Rhythm
lamps.rule: A heavy blow fires Dawnpulse as well, at most every 1.5 s (an arcanist: a kill by another spell).
lamps.from: v1 sunderer.dawnpulse.dawn_rhythm (it replaced the timer; now it adds to it, so a first lamp never costs pulses)

lamps.name: Where the Blow Falls
lamps.rule: A pulse fired by a heavy blow rises 3.75 m round where the blow landed, not about you (an arcanist: where the thing died).

lamps.name: Keep Time
lamps.rule: Dawnpulse's own timer runs 50% longer, but a heavy blow (an arcanist: a spell kill) may fire it every 0.8 s.

lamps.name: Dawn upon Dawn
lamps.rule: Each pulse goes off three times, 0.3 s apart, each at 70% damage and 85% size.

lamps.name: Third Blow
lamps.rule: Every 3rd swing is heavy, not every 4th.

lamps.name: Harvest
lamps.rule: A heavy blow that kills 3 or more makes the next swing heavy too.

lamps.name: Thrown Down
lamps.rule: Sunder swings 10% slower, but what a heavy blow throws back knocks down what it lands on, stunned 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Splitting Stroke
lamps.rule: Every second swing is heavy and splits the ground; Sunder swings 15% slower.

lamps.name: Wide Swing
lamps.rule: Sunder sweeps 300°, not 220°, and what it strikes at your back is thrown round in front of you.
lamps.from: v1 sunderer.sunder.wide_swing (the 300° is built; the throw round in front is new, so it is a shape and not more area)

lamps.name: Back Furrow
lamps.rule: The heavy line also runs 4 m behind you.
lamps.from: new (C2 lead 2: Two Furrows, a smaller Three Furrows, retires)

lamps.name: Plowshare
lamps.rule: Sunder swings 10% slower, but its heavy line throws what it strikes aside, opening a lane 2 m wide.

lamps.name: Three Furrows
lamps.rule: The heavy line splits in three, 25° apart, each running its full 7 m.

lamps.name: Burning Edge
lamps.rule: Sunder's heavy line sears what it strikes for 3 s.

lamps.name: Hot Iron
lamps.rule: Sunder strikes 15% softer, but every swing sears, not only the heavy line.

lamps.name: Tinder
lamps.rule: A heavy blow on a seared thing sets it burning 3 s, at 25% of the blow a second.

lamps.name: Watch-Fire
lamps.rule: Sunder takes holy fire: it becomes holy, and everything it sears burns 3 s at 25% of the blow a second.
lamps.from: built Turn holy (wicks.json; its x1.1 damage retires: rank carries power) plus a burn on all it sears (new)

lamps.name: Sinking Ground
lamps.rule: Before the heave strikes, everything within 4 m slides 1.5 m toward its heart.

lamps.name: Full Weight
lamps.rule: Every heave is heavy, not every 6th.
lamps.from: new (the warden's Hand makes every 6th firing heavy: hands.json warden.every)

lamps.name: Driven Deep
lamps.rule: Groundbreaker comes 1 s slower, but the heave's heart, 1 m round, strikes twice as hard.

lamps.name: Second Heave
lamps.rule: 0.8 s later the heave strikes the same spot again at 35%, stunning again.
lamps.from: built Turn groundbreaker.aftershock, renamed: Aftershock is a board link (lamps_v2.json)

lamps.name: Twin Cracks
lamps.rule: Groundbreaker opens two cracks, 30° apart, each to its own pack.

lamps.name: Fault Line
lamps.rule: The cracks run 14 m and stay open 2 s; what walks across one is slowed 40% for 1 s.
lamps.from: v1 sunderer.groundbreaker.fault_line (14 m is built; alone it was bare reach, so the open crack is added)

lamps.name: Thickest Press
lamps.rule: The cracks seek the thickest packs within 14 m, not the nearest.

lamps.name: Crow's Foot
lamps.rule: Each crack branches where it reaches its pack: a new crack runs on to the next pack within 8 m, 3 packs at most.
lamps.from: new (C2 lead 2: three cracks over Twin Cracks' two was one more of the same; now each crack branches)

lamps.name: Upheaval
lamps.rule: Lesser things the heave strikes are thrown up 0.8 s, and take 30% more while in the air.

lamps.name: Down They Come
lamps.rule: What falls from the air lands hard, striking 1.5 m round at 30% of the heave.

lamps.name: Great and Small
lamps.rule: Groundbreaker comes 20% slower, but champions are thrown up too, for 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Riven Earth
lamps.rule: The whole crack heaves: everything along it is thrown up 1 s, not only the pack at its end.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: a new Turn)

lamps.name: Thronged
lamps.rule: A rebuke that strikes 4 or more gives you a barrier of 2% of health, 20% held at most.

lamps.name: Broken Ward
lamps.rule: When your barrier breaks, Rebuke strikes everything within 5 m at once.

lamps.name: Glare
lamps.rule: While a barrier holds, Rebuke's light sears what it strikes for 3 s.

lamps.name: Shield of Morning
lamps.rule: While your barrier holds, Rebuke answers every blow on you, as often as every 0.2 s, and each rebuke gives a barrier of 1% of health for each thing it strikes, 4% at most, 20% held at most.
lamps.from: built Turn rebuke.morning (wicks.json): its barrier keys stay, at 1% a thing and 4% at most (were 0.1% and 0.4%); no wait while a barrier holds is new

lamps.name: Rebuke the Strong
lamps.rule: A champion's blow on you is rebuked at once, even inside its wait; the same champion once every 5 s.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.rebuke.rebuke_the_strong (twice as hard on champions was a bare bump; now champions are answered at once)

lamps.name: Brought Low
lamps.rule: A champion Rebuke strikes deals you 25% less for 3 s.

lamps.name: Dazed
lamps.rule: Rebuke strikes 3 fewer of the nearest, but a champion it strikes is stunned 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Humbled
lamps.rule: A rebuke on a champion is a heavy blow, and its light breaks out 4 m round the champion.

lamps.name: The Long Answer
lamps.rule: Rebuke's light runs on through the one that struck you, 6 m behind it, striking all in the line.
lamps.from: new (C2 lead 2 remade the strand so the light travels; v1 Answering Light, a 1% mend, retires)

lamps.name: Tidings
lamps.rule: Rebuke's light leaps on from the one that struck you: 3 leaps, each to the nearest thing within 4 m.
lamps.from: new (v1 Readier Wall retires: the wall's six Stones stay the calling's)

lamps.name: Slow to Anger
lamps.rule: Rebuke answers at most every 1 s, not every 0.5 s, but its light leaps 3 more times.

lamps.name: Open Rebuke
lamps.rule: Each rebuke breaks out in a ring of light 4 m round you, striking everything in it.
lamps.from: new (Grace, a mend capped at 2%, retires)

lamps.name: Alarm
lamps.rule: When the wall answers (at 6 Stones), the bell tolls at once and its timer starts over.

lamps.name: Millstone
lamps.rule: While you hold 3 or more Stones, what the bell draws lands stunned 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Cairn
lamps.rule: Each toll that draws 5 or more lays a Stone.

lamps.name: Stone Bell
lamps.rule: Each toll raises a ring of standing stones 5 m round you for 3 s: what the bell drew is shut in with you, and each thing that reaches the ring from outside is held there and lays a Stone, once a toll each.
lamps.from: built Turn watch_bell.stone (wicks.json: 2 Stones a toll, 1 more a champion, only more Stones on top of Cairn) retires; the nearest built shape is the director's closing ring (Ringed in the harness)

lamps.name: Loud Bell
lamps.rule: The bell tolls twice, 1 s apart: the second draws from 11 m and gives no barrier.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.watch_bell.loud_bell (drew from 10 m: bare reach; now a second, farther toll)

lamps.name: Arm's Length
lamps.rule: What the bell draws stops 2 m from you, in a ring, not at your feet.

lamps.name: In Their Wake
lamps.rule: Each champion the bell draws drags the 3 nearest lesser things with it.

lamps.name: Muster
lamps.rule: The bell draws everything within 10 m into a press 3 m before you, all facing you.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: the draw's shape)

lamps.name: Iron Bell
lamps.rule: What the bell draws is slowed 30% for 3 s.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.watch_bell.iron_bell (rule id named, not found in the sim)

lamps.name: Bell and Barrier
lamps.rule: Each slowed thing that strikes you gives you a barrier of 0.5% of health, 15% held at most.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.watch_bell.bell_and_barrier (1.5% a draw was a bare bump; now the slowed pay it)

lamps.name: Leaden
lamps.rule: The bell tolls 1 s slower, but its slow lasts until the next toll.

lamps.name: Long Toll
lamps.rule: For 3 s after each toll, whatever comes within 6 m is drawn in and slowed too.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: a new Turn)

lamps.name: Hide Like Iron
lamps.rule: The charge's barrier is 25% of health, not 15%.
lamps.from: the old Bull Rush lamp warden.iron_hide (lamps.json), on the skill

lamps.name: Unbowed
lamps.rule: Each thing the charge strikes adds a barrier of 2% of health, 20% held at most above the charge's own.
lamps.from: the old Bull Rush lamp warden.unbroken (lamps.json), on the skill

lamps.name: Goring Rush
lamps.rule: What the charge strikes bleeds for 80% of the blow over 4 s, and a champion that stops it takes 50% more.
lamps.from: the old Bull Rush lamp warden.gore (lamps.json), on the skill

lamps.name: Driven Home
lamps.rule: The charge ends in a slam: everything within 3 m is struck for 140% of its blow and stunned for 1 s.
lamps.from: evolution pile_driver (skills.json; the old Bull Rush lamp warden.pile_driver, on the skill)

lamps.name: Headlong
lamps.rule: The charge runs 12 m, not 8, in the same 0.3 s.

lamps.name: Swept Along
lamps.rule: Lesser things the charge strikes ride your shield to its end, 8 at most, and are thrown down there, stunned 1 s.

lamps.name: Breakthrough
lamps.rule: The charge strikes 20% softer, but no champion stops it: one it meets is struck as if it had, stunned 1 s, and you run on.
lamps.from: new (a champion met still counts as the stopper for Goring Rush)

lamps.name: Landslide
lamps.rule: At the charge's end, what rides your shield is hurled on along your line: a 3 m wide tumble of bodies that rolls 10 m, striking everything in it for 100% of the charge's blow.
lamps.from: new (Swept Along's riders are the bodies; with none, the last thing struck rolls)

lamps.name: Shield Up
lamps.rule: For 2 s after the charge, your shield blocks every blow from in front of you.

lamps.name: Rebound
lamps.rule: Each block takes 1 s off the charge's wait.

lamps.name: Sprung
lamps.rule: A perfect dash readies the charge at once, as often as every 3 s.

lamps.name: Stampede
lamps.rule: The charge holds 3 runs: press again within 2 s to charge on from where you stopped, each run striking 30% harder than the last; then it waits.

lamps.name: Crater

lamps.name: Second Quake
lamps.rule: 1 s after you land, the ring heaves again at 40% of the landing, stunning again.
lamps.from: new (groundbreaker.aftershock's shape; LandSkillLeap does not read the Turn key again)

lamps.name: Ninepins
lamps.rule: The leap waits 11 s, not 8, but what the landing throws flies 6 m and strikes what it lands on for 50% of the landing.

lamps.name: Henge

lamps.name: Far Spring
lamps.rule: The leap reaches 13 m, not 9, in the same 0.62 s.

lamps.name: Into the Thick

lamps.from: new (the aim assist made a lamp: the densest point within 4 m of the aim)

lamps.name: Unshackled
lamps.rule: Leaping breaks every slow and hold on you, and for 2 s after you land you run 30% faster.

lamps.name: Iron Comet
lamps.rule: Hold the key to hang aloft up to 1.5 s, untouchable, steering your landing with the cursor as far as 16 m.

lamps.name: Spring-Heeled
lamps.rule: A landing that kills 3 or more takes 4 s off the leap's wait.

lamps.name: War Pace
lamps.rule: For 3 s after you land, you swing and cast 25% faster.

lamps.name: Restless
lamps.rule: The leap strikes 20% softer, but a landing that kills 5 or more readies it at once.

lamps.name: Unending Bound
lamps.rule: After a landing that kills, press again within 1.5 s to leap on at once, as far as 9 m, 4 leaps in a row at most.

lamps.name: Laid Open
lamps.rule: Every chop bleeds, not 35% of them: 40% of the blow over 4 s.
lamps.from: new (skill.status cannot: Cleaver's own status wins in Weapons.StatusWith)

lamps.name: Spatter

lamps.name: Bled Dry
lamps.rule: Cleaver strikes 20% softer, but its bleeds deal all their damage in 1.5 s.

lamps.name: Rupture
lamps.rule: A chop on a bleeding thing tears it open: the rest of its bleed lands at once and splashes everything 2.5 m round for as much.

lamps.name: Overhand
lamps.rule: Every 3rd chop is heavy.
lamps.from: new (Cleaver has no heavy count of its own; the Turn key heavyEvery is Sunder's)

lamps.name: Hewn Down
lamps.rule: A heavy chop throws lesser things 3 m and knocks them down, stunned 0.6 s.

lamps.name: Giantsbane
lamps.rule: Cleaver chops 15% slower, but every chop on a champion is heavy.

lamps.name: Bonesplitter
lamps.rule: Each chop sends a shockwave 3.5 m ahead, 1.8 m round, at 80% of the chop, staggering what it strikes; a frozen thing under half its life shatters.
lamps.from: evolution bonesplitter (catalyst might goes; its mods damage 1.61, area 1.25 retire: rank carries the power)

lamps.name: Butcher's Hook
lamps.rule: Cleaver reaches 3.5 m, not 2.5 m, and drags what it strikes 1 m toward you.

lamps.name: Next Cut
lamps.rule: A chop that strikes 6 or more readies the next at once.

lamps.name: Light Grip
lamps.rule: Cleaver strikes 15% softer, but chops 25% faster.

lamps.name: Cross-Cut
lamps.rule: Every chop cuts twice: across your front, then back again 0.25 s later, each cut at 65% of the chop.
lamps.from: new (evolution whirlwind retires: the spin is Bladestorm's, the Cleaver + Sunder Union)

lamps.name: Kept Count
lamps.rule: The vow stores 35% of each blow on you, not 20%.

lamps.name: Nothing Wasted
lamps.rule: Each block in the brace stores 100% of the blow it turned.

lamps.name: Old Grudge
lamps.rule: Iron Vow waits 14 s, not 10, but bursts at 5 times what it stored, not 3.

lamps.name: Full Measure
lamps.rule: The burst becomes a shockwave: it runs 14 m toward the cursor, 3 m wide, throwing everything aside, at 2 times the ring's blow.

lamps.name: Steadfast
lamps.rule: The brace holds 3.5 s, not 2.

lamps.name: Anvil
lamps.rule: In the brace, blows on you are cut by 70%, not halved.

lamps.name: Iron March
lamps.rule: You walk at full speed in the brace, and lesser things you walk into are shoved 2 m aside.

lamps.name: Unyielding
lamps.rule: Hold the key to keep the brace up to 6 s, then let go: the burst reaches 5 m, and 1 m more for each second you held.
lamps.from: new (the press becomes a hold: a channel she walks in)

lamps.name: Vigil Flame
lamps.rule: The burst sears what it strikes for 3 s.
lamps.from: the rule skill.status (Weapons.StatusWith), if the burst strikes with its skill's status (the sim solver's call)

lamps.name: Like for Like
lamps.rule: Each blow on you in the brace strikes its striker back for 50% of the blow.

lamps.name: Penance
lamps.rule: The burst strikes 25% softer, but mends you for a third of what it stored, 15% of health at most.

lamps.name: Come Then
lamps.rule: As the brace begins, everything within 12 m drops what it was doing and rushes you, archers and casters too, and the burst reaches 7 m, not 5.
lamps.from: new (the taunt: ranged foes close to melee for the burst)

unions.needs: a Turn burning on each of its two skills (any one of each list); both skills keep firing
unions.name: Dawn's Judgment
unions.rule: The disc carries the dawn: it sears for 3 s, and wherever it strikes it breaks into light 2.2 m round, at 35% of the strike.
unions.from: union dawns_judgement (the merge into the dawns_judgement weapon and its freed slot go; that weapon's sear and its on-hit burst, the trigger as written in skills.json, become this lamp)

unions.needs: a Turn burning on each of its two skills (any one of each list); both skills keep firing
unions.name: Broken Country
unions.rule: Sunder's heavy line ends in Groundbreaker's heave: the earth rises there at 40%, stunning 0.4 s.

unions.needs: a Turn burning on each of its two skills (any one of each list); both skills keep firing
unions.name: Curfew
unions.rule: Each toll rebukes what it draws: Rebuke's light strikes everything the bell pulls in, at 100% of a rebuke, once a toll.
